visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman with long dark hair, wearing a beige sleeveless knit turtleneck, sits on a grey fabric sofa. She holds a black microphone to her mouth, singing with an emotional expression. The background features ornate teal and orange floral wallpaper and a white wooden door. A white text box is overlaid at the top of the frame, and white subtitles appear at the bottom. (2) The scene shifts to a medium close-up of the woman sitting at a wooden table, signing a photo album cover with a gold pen. She is smiling and looking toward an off-screen companion. A digital search bar graphic is overlaid on the album. The background shows a modern living room area with a sofa and personal items. (3) A man with short hair and glasses, wearing a red sleeveless top, appears on the grey sofa next to the woman. He holds the signed album and points toward it while talking animatedly. Large stylized white text with a heart icon is overlaid between them. Both characters are laughing and looking at each other in a brightly lit indoor studio environment.

[Subtitle]: 你保持得很好. (5) [Subtitle]: 謝謝 真的嗎？. (6) [Subtitle]: 這是真的！. (7) [Subtitle]: 真的嗎？. (8) [Subtitle]: 這是真的！. (9) [Subtitle]: 這是真的！. (10) [Subtitle]: 沒有在安慰我吧. (11) [Subtitle]: 沒有！我從鏡頭裡看.
